newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank bond rate rises to 2.5175 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank bond rate rises to 2.5175 pct.

text.p: Brazil's benchmark overnight rate rose to 2.5175 percent a month from 2.4697 percent last week, at today's 6.307 billion reais sale of 56-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC), dealers said.
The auction's result was in line with market expectations, they added.
The 56-day bonds will mature on February 19. Today's auction is expected to add 1.193 billion reais to the banking system, with 7.5 billion reais in old bonds coming due on Thursday.
The auction, usually held on Tuesdays, was held today due to Christmas holidays.
